record.dic_text:
08069 Shamiyr {shaw-meer'}

與 08068 同; 專有名詞 地名

AV - Shamir 3; 3

沙密 = "尖點" 或 "刺"
1) 猶大山區中的城鎮
2) 在以法蓮中城鎮, 亦即士師陀拉生活與埋葬之處
record.edic_text:
08069 Shamiyr {shaw-meer'}

the same as 08068; n pr loc

AV - Shamir 3; 3

Shamir = "a point" or "thorn"
n pr loc
1) a town in the mountain district of Judah
2) a town in Ephraim where the judge Tola lived and was buried
